summary: Recent updates in the Media IPC (Inter-Process Communication) area of Firefox focused on optimizing performance by implementing **std::move** in various modules. This adjustment allows the browser to transfer ownership of resources rather than duplicating them when they are passed around in memory. By doing so, Firefox can operate more efficiently, particularly when dealing with multimedia content like video and audio, leading to faster load times and smoother playback. While users may not notice any immediate visible changes, these under-the-hood improvements enhance the overall experience, especially for resource-intensive applications.
